Check quality before you order

Buyers need proof, not promises. Every quote request gets the documents below so your quality team can review before any commitment.

  • Specification sheet
    Colour, pungency, acidity, moisture and pack details.
  • Batch test report
    Lab results for the batch your sample comes from.
  • FSSAI licence copy
    So your compliance team can verify us.
  • Pre-order sample
    Test it in your own process first.

Launching your own brand?

We pack oil under your label. Here is how it works.

  1. Share your brand and pack.
    Tell us pack size, volume and target city.
  2. Approve sample and artwork.
    We send a sample; you confirm the label.
  3. We produce and pack.
    Your brand, filled and sealed at our mill.
  4. We dispatch to you.
    Delivered to your warehouse or distributor.

Questions buyers ask

What is the minimum order?

It depends on pack format. Tell us your quantity and we reply with the options that fit.

Can I get a sample first?

Yes. Tick “Send me a sample” in the quote form and we will arrange it.

How do I get a price?

Prices change with seed cost, pack and volume, so we quote per request. The form takes about two minutes.

Do you offer private labelling?

Yes. See the private-label steps above or tick the private-label box in the quote form.

Which documents can I get?

Specification sheet, batch test report and licence copy come with your quote.

Where do you deliver?

Add your delivery city in the form and we confirm freight and lead time in the quote.

Supplier questions

What happens after I send my interest?

We review your details and call you to talk about quantity, quality and location.

When do I see the buyer’s contact details?

After you accept a request. Until then you see the product, quantity, city and timeline only.

Do I have to accept every request?

No. You accept only the requests you want, and can pass on the rest.
